data.description:
## Context

The live review-bot tracker at `/var/gerrit/site/reviewbot-tickets` is healthy enough to accept local event commits but is currently 867 commits ahead and 20,063 behind `origin/tickets`. Each artifact write fetches and then fails three merge attempts, so all bot artifacts remain local. This divergence is independently defective even apart from missing artifact bug 5b09-4f3d-58cc-41e4.

## Plan

- Establish the exact merge base, divergence onset, conflicting paths, and first local/remote commits after the fork.
- Trace the startup, write, fetch, merge-driver, and push-retry paths that allowed an append-only tracker to accumulate unreconcilable history.
- Reproduce the confirmed mechanism against real temporary Git repositories under the rebar-debug RED→GREEN protocol.
- Repair the lifecycle/reconvergence defect without losing locally committed artifact events, then recover the live tracker and verify it remains synchronized across a fresh artifact write.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The precise changeable cause of the live 867-ahead/20,063-behind divergence is proven with commit/path/runtime evidence.
- [ ] Automated coverage reproduces the divergence mechanism before the fix and passes after it.
- [ ] All locally committed review-bot events are preserved while the live tracker reconverges with `origin/tickets`.
- [ ] A fresh live review artifact publishes to the shared branch and the tracker finishes at zero ahead/zero behind with a clean index and no recovery state.
- [ ] The repair lands through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and zero unresolved comments.
data.title: Review-bot tracker accumulates unreconcilable tickets-branch divergence
